target_customer: Companies and managers of remote teams who book online workshops for team building
problem: Remote teams lack shared activities. MerryMint lets teams discover and book virtual experiences led by expert guides.
business_model: Marketplace booking commission or per session fee for virtual team activities (not stated by a source)

founders.name: Yvonne Lin
founders.background_notes: YC page lists her as the only founder with no bio.

exit.reason: No shutdown or sale notice found. The 2020 era site shows no closure.

technical_complexity.rationale: A booking site connecting teams with workshop hosts over video is simple web engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Host relationships were the only asset and anyone could list the same instructors.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The site announced a partnership with Airbnb in 2020 and lists its experiences on Airbnb, so the largest platform became a distribution partner rather than a rival.

market_need_then: No dated evidence of demand at the Winter 2014 batch was found. Remote work demand for virtual activities rose sharply in 2020, which the later site reflects.

branding.domain_note: Uses merrymint.co, not the .com, per YC page.

identity.visual_style: Playful, activity photos (watercolor, pie baking, magic)

branding.community_and_virality: A Product Hunt page exists with about 2 followers per a search summary. No merch or community found.

brand_strength.rationale: Friendly name but no evidence of recognition. The footer reads Snackwalla Inc., a different entity name.

outcome_analysis: MerryMint was a one founder Winter 2014 company listed as inactive by YC, but its own site in the 2020 era still sold virtual team workshops and announced an Airbnb partnership. No funding, shutdown or acquisition information was found, so the cause of inactivity is not public and the record carries no failure factors. The description of remote team activities does not obviously fit a 2014 launch, which suggests the product changed over time, but no dated source confirms a pivot.
notes: Competitor list is empty because nothing dated near January 2014 was found; search surfaced only current competitors (Breakout Experiences, Vispa) on CB Insights. Crunchbase shows placeholder values with no usable funding. Site footer says copyright 2020 Snackwalla Inc., relationship to MerryMint not explained. The page described was observed once and may reflect a later owner. Founder education and prior employers not found.
